blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers have been warned about presenting video clips of former Chief Justice Renato Corona testifying during his own impeachment trial, with at least two senator-judges noting that the former Supreme Court head was convicted despite his grievances. During Duterte’s impeachment trial on Thursday, defense counsel Mark Vinluan presented clips of Corona complaining about the treatment he and his family received just to remove him from his post—claiming they had been harassed by different government offices probing his alleged ill-gotten wealth.
